patthana16.8:1.1: abyākato sanidassano dhammo na abyākatassa na sanidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. na kusalassa na sanidassanassa …pe… chapañhā kātabbā.
patthana16.8:2.1: kusalaṃ anidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na anidassano dhammo ... akusalena tīṇiyeva. abyākatena tīṇiyeva. nava. kusalattika sappaṭighaduke nakusalattika nasappaṭighadukaṃ
